project.name: GJ 411 b Milestone 13 held-out detector-v0.5 validation
project.scientific_target: An intermittent narrowband signal coherent under the selected GJ 411 b motion hypothesis; the signal is not assumed to originate on the planet or to be aimed at Earth
project.selection_rule: Select GJ 411 as the nearest eligible confirmed-planet host among the metadata-screened targets once the official Breakthrough Listen archive supplies a complete 2016-06-03 GBT L-band ABACAD cadence and all six current fine-resolution products pass identical header, duration, frequency-coverage, and byte-range checks.
project.survey_scope: New target, observing date, source payload, and storage format relative to Milestone 11. Telescope, five frequency intervals, recurrence statistic, thresholds, spectral widths, orbital bank, RFI mask, empirical calibration, and completeness procedure remain frozen.
project.method_note: The HDF5 adapter writes the same NPZ contract as the SIGPROC extractor and does not alter detector v0.5.0. No search threshold, veto, template-grid rule, activity-subset rule, or candidate-reporting rule may change after this commit.
project.prior_data_contact: The public target catalogue, archive API records, HTTP metadata, and HDF5 attributes/shape/dtype/chunking were inspected. The selected HDF5 data datasets were never indexed or sliced before this preregistration.
project.control_cadence_note: Each ON and OFF scan contains 16 integrations of 17.986224128 s. The source sequence is GJ411, HIP52936, GJ411, HIP52941, GJ411, HIP53002.
project.observing_session_limit: All three ON scans occur within one approximately 30-minute ABACAD session on 2016-06-03. They are recurrence opportunities within a cadence, not independent observing nights.
project.orbit_source: NASA Exoplanet Archive Planetary Systems default solution for GJ 411 b, citing Hurt et al. 2022: period 12.9394 d, semimajor axis 0.07879 au, eccentricity 0.063, periastron epoch BJD 2456307.8, and longitude/argument value -30 deg.
project.orbital_phase_convention: The archive value pl_orblper is used as omega and converted from -30 degrees to radians. The unknown inclination is handled only through the already frozen projected-scale bank; the plus/minus 0.2-cycle phase-offset bank remains unchanged.
project.source_location_note: GJ 411 b supplies a predicted motion template, not a proven source location. A surviving feature could originate elsewhere within the telescope response or be terrestrial, spaceborne, or instrumental interference.
project.data_release: Breakthrough Listen Green Bank Telescope public L-band fine HDF5 products; cadence --72283
